This course runs **August 24 – December 9, 2026**, meeting **Mondays and Wednesdays**. Complete all assigned reading **before** the session it is listed under, and bring five copies of your session notes to class (one for me, and one for each of you). I will do my best to adhere to the schedule below, but it is a living document and I reserve the right to alter it as the semester progresses.

::: {.info-box}
### {{< fa book >}} Readings
Six books anchor the course (see the [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd) for full citations); articles are posted on Canvas.
:::
